title: Umbel event as a sealed caller sees it, version 1
description: An event as event-list presents it to a caller whose positions are sealed (phase 5 section 9.3, D125: a hosted caller that is neither the operator nor stdio). It is the stored line (event versions 0 to 3) with every field that counts events or store revisions left out or sealed, so nothing the caller is shown moves with an event or a write it cannot read: no seq, journalSeq or changes; no record version; id and cursor both the event's cursor version 1, sealed for this caller, which only equality may compare and event-list and event-ack take back. Every other field is the line's, under the version it was written in.

id.description: The event's cursor version 1: unique for this caller, and equal on every read of the event.

cursor.description: The cursor version 1 that resumes after this event.

record.description: The record the command named, without its version, or null.

provenance.description: The line's provenance envelope, in the version it was written in.
